release_notes: Location tracking now keeps working while the app is closed. Previously tracking silently stopped once the app had been closed for a while, leaving gaps in location history. The app now resumes tracking on its own, including after being closed for a long time, as long as you stay signed in. Signing out still pauses tracking until you sign in again. The Geo Tracking screen's battery and app settings shortcut now opens the battery-optimization list so background tracking is not suspended by the phone.
